tex_content.html:
\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch5:5-12

Suppose $M$ is a connected $n$-dimensional Riemannian manifold, and $G$ is a Lie group acting isometrically and effectively on $M$. Show that $\dim G \leq n(n+1)/2$. (Used on p. 261.) \end{exercise}
